title: Glowing Tide Pool
description: A shallow pool nestled among the rocks pulses with faint bioluminescence. Tiny creatures dart beneath the surface, trailing ribbons of light. Salt crystals rim the edges like frosted glass.

choices.label: Harvest the kelp
choices.description: The fibrous strands make excellent sinew for binding.

outcomes.text: The kelp pulls free in long, strong strands. Perfect material for cord and bindings.
You gather a decent bundle, but a tiny bioluminescent jellyfish stings your wrist as you reach deeper.
The kelp is brittle and sun-bleached. You salvage what you can from the deeper strands.

choices.label: Collect salt crystals from the rim
choices.description: The crystallized deposits are pure and valuable.

outcomes.text: The crystals break off in satisfying chunks. Pure sea salt, worth good coin to any alchemist.
You chip away at the deposits, but half crumble to powder. Still a worthwhile haul.
A sharp crystal shard slices your palm as it breaks free. The salt stings fiercely in the wound.

choices.label: Wait and watch
choices.description: The gentle light soothes aching muscles and frayed nerves.

outcomes.text: The party rests beside the pool, mesmerized by the drifting lights. The warmth of the bioluminescence eases aches and lifts spirits.
